description: Reads a domain's subdomains from live certificate transparency and groups them for recon triage: development and test, staging, admin and internal tools, APIs, authentication, mail, remote access (VPN), storage and CDN, legacy and backup. Each group has a count, examples and why it matters. Also returns naming clusters (for example *.eu.example.com), certificate issuers in use, wildcard entries and the 10 newest names. Passive only.

domain.description: Registered domain, for example "example.com". A URL is accepted and reduced to its host.

include_expired.description: Also include names from expired certificates (uses crt.sh). Finds retired hosts; slower.

source.description: auto = certspotter first (fast, unexpired certificates), crt.sh if it fails or throttles. crtsh = crt.sh only (includes expired with include_expired).
